title: mardbeads
description: Adds all 291 official MARD fuse bead colors as decorative blocks, organized into dedicated creative tabs for virtual bead art in Minecraft.
body:
Description
Overview

MARD Beads brings the complete official MARD 291-color fuse bead palette into Minecraft as decorative blocks.

Each color is represented by its own block with a solid-color texture based on the corresponding MARD color. The mod is designed for players who enjoy fuse bead art, pixel art, color palette design, or decorative building in Minecraft.

Features
291 official MARD fuse bead colors
One decorative block for each color
Dedicated Creative Mode tabs for every MARD color series:
A
B
C
D
E
F
G
H
M
P
Q
R
T
Y
ZG
Simple solid-color textures that match the corresponding MARD colors
Localized names
Optimized resource generation using Forge Data Generator
Intended Use

This mod is intended for:

Creating virtual fuse bead artwork
Pixel art projects
Decorative building
Color palette reference
Creative mode building

It does not add survival progression, crafting mechanics, or gameplay changes. Its primary purpose is to provide an accurate decorative color library based on the official MARD fuse bead palette.

Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1
Forge 47.x
Client and single-player focused
Can also be used on servers where decorative blocks are desired
Notes

This project is an unofficial fan-made mod inspired by the MARD fuse bead color system. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by MARD.
